name: Marked Riwaq
summary: An oblique mosque rests beside a minaret that continues into a bold Quran bookmark.
why: The front wall, dome and doorway are sheared together, preserving their shared local axis. The side wall meets the front at x=66. The minaret joins the hall at x=38–44, and its lower shaft becomes a single forked bookmark rather than a separate object.
risk: The bookmark is an abstract reading cue; its fork and oblique side window are clearest from 48px upward.
sub1: The minaret becomes a Quran bookmark
sub2: Roof, entrance and floor follow the same perspective
reasonToChoose: A non-front-facing mosque with an integrated Quran-reading motif.
